[`SimulationContainer.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R012_module_java/SimulationContainer.java:9) now owns weather, rules, species config access, per-species attributes, factories, and population seeding rules.
